verdict.rationale: Supermemory is positioned as a memory API/infrastructure layer that other AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) connect to via MCP — the evidence describes external assistants using Supermemory tools, not a built-in assistant inside Supermemory itself that a user delegates tasks to. There's no documentation of a native task-executing assistant, only memory ingestion, search, and MCP connectors for third-party agents.
